INSERT INTO execution_step (id, tenant_id, submission_id, preview_id, bc_id, unit_id, kind, step_key, group_id, planned_ad_id, material_id, parent_step_id, distribution_id, cover_job_id, status, phase, remote_id, attempt, lease_token, lease_expires_at, request_body, request_body_digest, resolved, error_code, operation_status, review_status, mismatch, checked_at, due_at, dispatch_revision, dispatch_id, updated_at) VALUES (%(id)s::UUID, %(tenant_id)s::UUID, %(submission_id)s::UUID, %(preview_id)s::UUID, %(bc_id)s::VARCHAR, %(unit_id)s::UUID, %(kind)s::VARCHAR, %(step_key)s::VARCHAR, %(group_id)s::UUID, %(planned_ad_id)s::UUID, %(material_id)s::UUID, %(parent_step_id)s::UUID, %(distribution_id)s::UUID, %(cover_job_id)s::UUID, %(status)s::VARCHAR, %(phase)s::VARCHAR, %(remote_id)s::VARCHAR, %(attempt)s::INTEGER, %(lease_token)s::UUID, %(lease_expires_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(request_body)s::JSONB, %(request_body_digest)s::VARCHAR, %(resolved)s::JSONB, %(error_code)s::VARCHAR, %(operation_status)s::VARCHAR, %(review_status)s::VARCHAR, %(mismatch)s, %(checked_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(due_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(dispatch_revision)s::INTEGER, %(dispatch_id)s::UU

SELECT build_unit.id, build_unit.tenant_id, build_unit.preview_id, build_unit.bc_id, build_unit.drama_id, build_unit.advertiser_id, build_unit.connection_id, build_unit.currency, build_unit.timezone, build_unit.campaign_name, build_unit.campaign_digest, build_unit.readiness, build_unit.reason_codes, build_unit.scene_snapshot, build_unit.group_count, build_unit.ad_count, build_unit.complete FROM build_unit WHERE build_unit.tenant_id = %(tenant_id_1)s::UUID AND build_unit.id = %(id_1)s::UUID AND build_unit.preview_id = %(preview_id_1)s::UUID

SELECT build_unit.id, build_unit.tenant_id, build_unit.preview_id, build_unit.bc_id, build_unit.drama_id, build_unit.advertiser_id, build_unit.connection_id, build_unit.currency, build_unit.timezone, build_unit.campaign_name, build_unit.campaign_digest, build_unit.readiness, build_unit.reason_codes, build_unit.scene_snapshot, build_unit.group_count, build_unit.ad_count, build_unit.complete FROM build_unit WHERE build_unit.tenant_id = %(tenant_id_1)s::UUID AND build_unit.preview_id = %(preview_id_1)s::UUID AND build_unit.id > %(id_1)s::UUID ORDER BY build_unit.id LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER

SELECT submission_unit.tenant_id, submission_unit.submission_id, submission_unit.unit_id, submission_unit.preview_id, submission_unit.bc_id, submission_unit.disposition, submission_unit.reason_code, submission_unit.expanded, submission_unit.dispatch_revision, submission_unit.dispatch_id, submission_unit.due_at, submission_unit.repair_after FROM submission_unit WHERE submission_unit.tenant_id = %(tenant_id_1)s::UUID AND submission_unit.submission_id = %(submission_id_1)s::UUID AND submission_unit.expanded IS false ORDER BY submission_unit.unit_id LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER

INSERT INTO draft_unit_reservation (tenant_id, draft_id, drama_id, advertiser_id, bc_id, submission_id, preview_id, unit_id) VALUES (%(tenant_id)s::UUID, %(draft_id)s::UUID, %(drama_id)s::UUID, %(advertiser_id)s::VARCHAR, %(bc_id)s::VARCHAR, %(submission_id)s::UUID, %(preview_id)s::UUID, %(unit_id)s::UUID)

UPDATE submission_unit SET dispatch_id=%(dispatch_id)s::UUID, due_at=%(due_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, repair_after=%(repair_after)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE WHERE submission_unit.tenant_id = %(submission_unit_tenant_id)s::UUID AND submission_unit.submission_id = %(submission_unit_submission_id)s::UUID AND submission_unit.unit_id = %(submission_unit_unit_id)s::UUID

UPDATE submission_unit SET expanded=%(expanded)s WHERE submission_unit.tenant_id = %(submission_unit_tenant_id)s::UUID AND submission_unit.submission_id = %(submission_unit_submission_id)s::UUID AND submission_unit.unit_id = %(submission_unit_unit_id)s::UUID

INSERT INTO submission_unit (tenant_id, submission_id, unit_id, preview_id, bc_id, disposition, reason_code, expanded, dispatch_revision, dispatch_id, due_at, repair_after) VALUES (%(tenant_id)s::UUID, %(submission_id)s::UUID, %(unit_id)s::UUID, %(preview_id)s::UUID, %(bc_id)s::VARCHAR, %(disposition)s::VARCHAR, %(reason_code)s::VARCHAR, %(expanded)s, %(dispatch_revision)s::INTEGER, %(dispatch_id)s::UUID, %(due_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(repair_after)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)

INSERT INTO pending_dispatch (id, tenant_id, actor_id, task_name, task_key, payload, available_at, attempts) VALUES (%(id)s::UUID, %(tenant_id)s::UUID, %(actor_id)s::UUID, %(task_name)s::VARCHAR, %(task_key)s::VARCHAR, %(payload)s::JSONB, %(available_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(attempts)s::INTEGER) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, task_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING pending_dispatch.id
